summary: Reviewed the IMPLEMENT-phase code against design.md D1-D8 and found the routing, retention, read-only-contract, and D4 characterization-guard wiring all correct. One quality issue: parse_run_id in skills/shared/artifact_paths.py returned a 3-tuple for ordinary run ids and a 4-tuple when a D8 collision suffix was present, even though the only production caller (list_active_runs) discarded the result entirely. Fixed by splitting it into a fixed 3-tuple return plus a new run_id_suffix() accessor. All four quality gates green.
completed_work: Verified D1 destination layout (openspec/choices/<run-id>/ with latest.* pointers) matches choices_paths.py
Verified D5 routing helper (route_output_dir) is keyed on the recorded change_id prefix only, in run_audit.py/choices_paths.py
Verified D6 read-only contract and its three-part closed write set via test_readonly_posture.py's snapshot assertions
Verified D7 run-directory naming from resolved_now/resolved_git_sha, never the header run_id or audited head_sha
Verified D8 collision guard (-2/-3 suffixes, checked against both active and archive paths) and retention-never-fails-a-successful-run behavior

Verified D4's three-part characterization guard: test_priorities_paths.py, test_retention.py, test_smoke_e2e.py, and prioritize-proposals/SKILL.md are byte-unchanged from the merge-base with main (git diff --quiet confirmed before and after this iteration's edits)

Verified D3: no re-exported name (build_run_id, RUN_ID_RE, parse_run_id, apply_retention, list_active_runs, RetentionResult, ARCHIVE_DIRNAME) is redefined in skills/prioritize-proposals/scripts/ -- only imported/re-exported

Refactored parse_run_id in skills/shared/artifact_paths.py from a variable-arity (3-or-4-tuple) return into a fixed 3-tuple, and added run_id_suffix(name) -> str | None to read the D8 collision suffix separately
Updated skills/tests/shared/test_artifact_paths.py and skills/tests/audit-choices/test_output_routing.py for the new accessor (both are this change's own new tests, not part of D4's frozen set)
Updated design.md's D8 paragraph to describe the fixed-arity parser plus accessor instead of the variable-arity return
Appended an Implementation Iteration 1 session-log entry and wrote this handoff

Confirmed all four quality gates green: 366 passed / 1 skipped (up from baseline 363/1, +3 for the new run_id_suffix tests) across audit-choices, shared, prioritize-proposals, and ci_coverage tests; both linters (install.sh --check, dependency_direction.py) clean
decisions: Split parse_run_id into a fixed-arity parser plus a separate run_id_suffix() accessor rather than keeping the variable-arity (3-or-4-tuple) return, because the only production caller (list_active_runs) discarded the parsed result as a pure validity check, and the frozen prioritize-proposals tests only ever unpack three values -- so nothing depended on the wider tuple, while a shape-dependent return arity is an ergonomic hazard for any future caller.

Documented this in design.md's D8 paragraph rather than leaving the design doc describing the old variable-arity shape, since the doc made a specific claim ('parse_run_id returns it') that would otherwise drift from the implementation.
next_steps: No further findings above the medium threshold identified in this iteration; the implementation is ready for /validate-feature
If another iteration is dispatched, it can start from a clean baseline (366 passed / 1 skipped, both linters clean) at commit 6600d172
